title: RequirementsAnalysisResult
description: Strict output contract for the requirements_analysis skill. Every acceptance criterion must carry a verbatim evidence quote that src/agents/grounding.js verifies against the real source text.

status.description: success requires >=1 criterion; conflicting_evidence only when conflicts leave no usable criterion; both abstain statuses require acceptance_criteria to be empty. validation_failed is reserved for the harness.

statement.description: The testable criterion, as an assertion about system behavior.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim span copied from source_field. Paraphrase is rejected by grounding validation. Minimum 12 characters after whitespace normalization.

source_field.description: Evidence field the quote came from, e.g. 'description', 'comments[2]', 'attachment:mockup.png'.

conflicts.description: Per-criterion contradictions the precedence rule could not settle. Each quote is grounding-checked; the affected criterion is withheld pending a PO decision.

missing_information.description: Required non-empty when status is insufficient_information.

overall_confidence.description: Below 0.75, requires_human_review is forced true in code by enforce_confidence_gate.

notes.description: Optional brief context; never a substitute for evidence.
